description_en: Starts a sensitive data identification task for Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用DsgRunSensIdentify接口启动一个数据保护伞的敏感数据识别任务
name: DsgRunSensIdentify

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the Data Studio page, click the current username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Information to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: The cluster ID. You can obtain the ID from your data source cluster
fields.help_zh: 集群ID。根据您自己的数据源集群获取
fields.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
ODPS.ODPS
EMR
HOLO.POSTGRES
fields.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值如下：
ODPS.ODPS
EMR
HOLO.POSTGRES
fields.name: db_type

fields.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain the ID from your data source
fields.help_zh: 实例ID。根据您的数据源获取
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Configuration page to obtain the workspace name
fields.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称
fields.name: project_name

fields.help_en: The username of the operator. We recommend that you enter your Alibaba Cloud account name
fields.help_zh: 操作者的用户名。建议填写您的阿里云账号名称
fields.name: user

parameters.help_en: The list of parameter objects for metadata scanning
parameters.help_zh: 指定元数据扫描的参数对象列表
parameters.name: es_meta_params

Data.description_en: The ID of the generated sensitive data identification task. The data type is INT64
Data.description_zh: 生成的敏感数据识别任务的任务ID。INT 64类型

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
